name: prefunk
description: Local deterministic security preflight for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Scan locally, verify potential security issues, and fix safely.
interface.longDescription: Prefunk runs a read-only local security preflight, gives Codex redacted structured leads, and requires independent verification before changes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run a Prefunk security preflight on this project, verify every potential finding, and propose the smallest safe fixes.
